2607.25865.title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
2607.25865.paper_summary: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, discovering QEC codes that remain effective is challenging, as logical performance depends on the interplay between code structure, hardware, syndrome extraction, and decoding, which often impose competing requirements. Here we introduce OmniQEC, an efficient AI scientist for discovering QEC codes suited to deployment on modern quantum processors. OmniQEC formulates QEC design as an iterative discovery process in which an orchestrator, implemented by advanced large language models (LLMs), coordinates code generation, code-level screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation. At its core, OmniQEC combines a self-evolving reasoning mechanism with a slow--fast synergistic workflow: a fast loop explores candidates using inexpensive code-level proxies, whereas a slow loop performs physically grounded circuit-level evaluation and feeds the resulting evidence back into the search. We evaluate OmniQEC across four qLDPC construction families, three LLM backends, and $14$ total-physical-qubit budgets per backend. The discovered codes show steadily improving logical-error suppression with increasing physical-qubit budgets and outperform the BB codes with $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ and $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ under complete-implementation budgets of 98 and 240 physical qubits, respectively. The discovered codes are hardware-friendly and may be of independent interest for practical QEC implementation. These findings pave the way towards LLM-assisted QEC discovery grounded in physically informed code--circuit--decoder co-design.
2607.25865.paper_summary_zh: 量子錯誤修正（QEC）對於可擴展的容錯量子計算是不可或缺的。然而，發現仍然有效的 QEC 代碼是具有挑戰性的，因為邏輯性能依賴於代碼結構、硬體、綜合提取和解碼之間的相互作用，這些通常會施加相互競爭的要求。在此，我們介紹 OmniQEC，一個高效的 AI 科學家，用於發現適合在現代量子處理器上部署的 QEC 代碼。OmniQEC 將 QEC 設計公式化為一個迭代發現過程，其中一個由先進的大型語言模型（LLMs）實現的協調者，協調代碼生成、代碼級篩選、綜合提取合成和基於解碼器的電路評估。在其核心，OmniQEC 結合了一個自我演化的推理機制和一個慢--快的協同工作流程：快速循環使用廉價的代碼級代理探索候選者，而慢速循環則進行物理基礎的電路級評估，並將結果證據反饋到搜索中。我們在四個 qLDPC 構建家族、三個 LLM 後端和每個後端 $14$ 個總物理量子位預算上評估 OmniQEC。所發現的代碼顯示出隨著物理量子位預算的增加，邏輯錯誤抑制穩步改善，並在完全實施預算為 98 和 240 物理量子位的情況下，超越了 $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ 和 $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ 的 BB 代碼。所發現的代碼對硬體友好，並可能對實際的 QEC 實施具有獨立的興趣。這些發現為基於物理知識的代碼--電路--解碼器共同設計的 LLM 輔助 QEC 發現鋪平了道路。
